# Test fixtures

`applicant-profile.json` represents a fictional applicant for isolated local QA and browser fixtures. Its home address is the user-supplied campus test location, 411 Morrill Rd, Ames, IA 50011; it is not a claim that the fictional applicant lives there and is never a default in a real user profile. It includes every current profile key, explicit Yes/No choices, and separate home and mailing addresses. Its phone numbers use the reserved 555-0100–0199 range, email uses `.invalid`, and SSN is blank. Its fictional household list has the applicant, two children (one a student in 5th grade) and a parent over 65, so age-band counts and the student answer have something to count; its manual household counts match that list.

Automated tests must never send this data to the live Iowa portal; intercept all portal requests in an isolated browser. A separately authorized manual live inspection used fictional answers on September 26, 2026 and stopped before signing or submitting; see [the journey record](../../docs/iowa-live-journey.md). That one-off authorization is not permission for tests or future runs to send fixture data live. Tests may clone it to exercise unknown choices, no home address, same-as-home mailing, alternate program selections, and missing required information. It does not supply defaults to the real desktop profile.
